{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the presence of internal test orders (revenue = '999999.99')
internal_test_mask = (df['revenue'] == '999999.99')
internal_test_count = internal_test_mask.sum()

# Check status counts
completed_status_count = (df['status'] == 'completed').sum()
refunded_status_count = (df['status'] == 'refunded').sum()

# Check for commas in revenue
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
commas_count = has_commas.sum()

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
df['revenue_float'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter for completed orders
completed_df = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Exclude internal test orders (if any)
final_df = completed_df[completed_df['revenue_float'] != 999999.99]

# Total revenue from completed orders
total_revenue_completed = final_df['revenue_float'].sum()

# Number of completed orders after exclusion
completed_count_after_exclusion = len(final_df)

# Print all required values
print(f'Internal test orders (revenue == 999999.99): {internal_test_count}')
print(f'Completed orders: {completed_status_count}')
print(f'Refunded orders: {refunded_status_count}')
print(f'Rows with commas in revenue: {commas_count}')
print(f'Number of completed orders after excluding internal test orders: {completed_count_after_exclusion}')
print(f'Total revenue from completed orders: {total_revenue_completed:,.2f}')"}
